Scan using a JSONL file. The file has to have a JSON object with the following structure on each line:

{
	"request":{
		"method":"POST",
		"endpoint":"http://example.com/path",
		"body":"name=kirlia",
		"headers":{
			"Content-Type":"application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
		}
	}
}

Usage:
  tinja jsonl [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help           help for jsonl
  -j, --jsonl string   JSONL file with crawl results

Global Flags:
      --config string          set the path for a config file to be read
  -c, --cookie strings         add custom cookie(s)
      --csti                   enable scanning for Client-Side Template Injections using a headless browser
      --escapereport           escape HTML special chars in the JSON report
  -H, --header strings         add custom header(s)
      --precedinglength int    how many chars shall be memorized, when getting the preceding chars of a body reflection point (default 30)
      --proxycertpath string   set the path for the certificate of the proxy
      --proxyurl string        set the URL of the proxy
  -r, --ratelimit float        number of requests per seconds. 0 is infinite (default 0)
      --reportpath string      set the path for a report to be generated
      --subsequentlength int   how many chars shall be memorized, when getting the subsequent chars of a body reflection point (default 30)
      --testheaders strings    headers to test. E.g. --testheaders Host,Origin,X-Forwarded-For
      --timeout int            seconds until timeout (default 15)
      --useragentchrome        set chrome as user-agent. Default user-agent is 'TInjA v1.2.0'
  -v, --verbosity int          verbosity of the output. 0 = quiet, 1 = default, 2 = verbose (default 1)

raw.--subsequentlength: how many chars shall be memorized, when getting the subsequent chars of a body reflection point (default 30)
raw.--useragentchrome: set chrome as user-agent. Default user-agent is 'TInjA v1.2.0'
raw.--verbosity: verbosity of the output. 0 = quiet, 1 = default, 2 = verbose (default 1)
raw.-v: verbosity of the output. 0 = quiet, 1 = default, 2 = verbose (default 1)

url.--data: add data to the body and use POST method
url.-d: add data to the body and use POST method
url.--lengthlimit: limit the polyglot length. 0 is unlimited (default 0)
url.--config: set the path for a config file to be read
url.--csti: enable scanning for Client-Side Template Injections using a headless browser
url.--escapereport: escape HTML special chars in the JSON report
url.--precedinglength: how many chars shall be memorized, when getting the preceding chars of a body reflection point (default 30)
url.--proxycertpath: set the path for the certificate of the proxy
url.--proxyurl: set the URL of the proxy
url.--ratelimit: number of requests per seconds. 0 is infinite (default 0)
